fusions.name: Scalding Edge
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that costs 5% of your maximum health, deals 9 fire damage and sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Rolling Boil
fusions.desc: Scalds every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 10 fire damage and sets each [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Warm-Blooded Surge
fusions.desc: Raises your attack speed by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Blood Heat
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your physical damage rises by 20% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
